answer: A farm of 290 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are entered in nadir, queued in copper, and velvet publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 96 identities per epoch. A farm of 3316 identities would post 3684 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
